data.title: 法琳 · 把药草留在最上层
data.description: 旅店的木桌上铺开了旅行包。法琳把晒干的药草包放到最容易拿到的位置，再用布带束好，免得和餐具撞在一起。
data.promptProse: In a modest inn room, Falin wears a blue-and-white mage robe and brown belt. She sits at a wooden table, placing a small dried-herb pouch at the top of an open travel pack and tying its cloth ribbon. Quiet window light falls across the folded supplies.
data.animaCaption: The herb pouch stays separate from the wrapped utensils inside the open pack.
data.action: 把药草包放进旅行包最上层并系好布带
